children: AB Akola Group plans to invest €52M in 2026/2027, including €38M in Food Production, €9M in Partners for Farmers and €5M in Farming. The plan may be revised as projects progress; investment was €43M in 2025/2026.
Signals a substantial planned capital commitment; actual amounts and schedules may change.
Most planned spending targets production capacity and modernization, supporting the stated focus on higher-value products and cost efficiency.
Includes €4.5M for a grain elevator, expanding collection and storage infrastructure.
Planned spending includes robotic milking systems, farm infrastructure and machinery.
The new plan is €9M higher than the prior financial year's investment; planned versus actual amounts may differ.

This continues an established investment programme, following €212M invested over the past five financial years, including €69M in 2024/2025 and €43M in 2025/2026. Execution and subsequent disclosure of actual spending, project timing and returns would determine whether the plan becomes a larger catalyst.
